title: De Snel
summary_html: Master De Snel is a trainer and the head of the prestigious fighting academy, the Library of Scars, in Jhelom and a former chief assassin for the Fellowship. Encountered by the Avatar in Ultima VII, De Snel’s past comes back to haunt him when the hero investigates a murder in Minoc linked to his academy. His talent as a fighter, coupled with his ruthless nature, makes him a dangerous adversary.
